facts.claim: The national Australian Mathematics Competition began in 1978; primary divisions were introduced in 2002.
MAWA means Mathematical Association of Western Australia. Its Problem Solving Program began in 1992 and develops problem solving and logical presentation of solutions.
Rossmoyne's selective-entry Honours Mathematics Program explores mathematics beyond the curriculum. Honours students form the Fermat Club and meet for collaborative problem solving and fun.

editorial_notes: No admissions guarantees, score guarantees, unofficial award thresholds or future application dates.
MAWA PSP is described as a programme with application problems, not conflated with PEAC or a timed AMC-style exam.
The dot-square demonstration is an original illustration of a general mathematical identity, not a reproduced exam question.
The narrator is Kokoro af_heart, used in the approved AMC solution pilot. No claim of exact imitation of an external narrator.
Confidence comes from curiosity, careful reasoning, practice and review; the learner is not told he must already know the answers.
